subject: ShuttleTech renewal — term flexibility & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Michael O'Neill <michael.oneill@shuttletech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@shuttletech.com>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@shuttletech.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal options — term and capacity

Hi Rachel / Marcus,

Hope you're both well. Our current commitment with Redwood is up in August and usage has grown faster than we anticipated (Q1 burst + new features). We need to firm up renewal terms by end of June.

High-level ask: can you share options for (A) a 24-month renewal with a tiered capacity uplift, and (B) a 12-month renewal with a higher discount/credit to align to our FY28 budget? Key constraints from our side:
- Procurement prefers a price hold for at least 90 days during internal approvals
- We can accelerate a portion of the commit (approx +20%) at mid-term if needed, but not all upfront
- We need a one-time onboarding/migration credit for the extra capacity ramp

Can you send a 1-page commercial with the two options and any flexibility on phased commits? We can schedule a call next week.

Thanks,
Michael O'Neill
Head of Data Platform
ShuttleTech
(attachment: usage_report_q1.csv)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neill <michael.oneill@shuttletech.com>, Procurement <procurement@shuttletech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options — term and capacity

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear ask and usage report. High level we can propose two clean paths so your procurement/legal teams have something to compare: 

Option A — 12 months, accelerated commit
- +30% committed units year-over-year
- 10% recurring discount off list unit price
- $60k one-time onboarding credit to offset burst costs
- Price hold: 60 days from signature

Option B — 24 months, term-led economics
- 18% recurring discount off list unit price (locked for Term 1)
- Tiered pricing after the first 12 months with step-down unit rates if commit thresholds met
- $40k onboarding credit
- Price hold: 90 days from signature

We can also do a hybrid 18-month with phased commits (see attached proposal v2) if you prefer a middle ground. Marcus and Neha are looping in finance/legal on Redwood's side to confirm margin and contract language.

If helpful I can host a 30-min commercial+procurement call Thursday 5/13 at 10am PT.

Attachments: ShuttleTech_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf (commercial compares options)

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: ShuttleTech_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Renewal options — pricing notes (internal)

Internal note — quick math and margin sensitivity:

- Option A (12m +30%) gives decent ARR acceleration but worst margin in year 1; credit eats into TCV but improves renewal velocity
- Option B (24m) preserves margin over life and reduces churn risk; need to confirm legal on auto-renew/termination language
- Proposed alternative (my suggestion): 18m phased commit
  * Year 1: +15% commit at signed rate (discount 16%)
  * Month 7: additional +10% at a pre-agreed uplift that is <= current list price (this is the phased commit)
  * $50k migration credit tied to usage thresholds in quarter 1

If Rachel wants to offer credits, keep them tied to milestone (onboarding / usage) rather than an unconditional cash concession. That preserves upside.

—Marcus
Director, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Michael O'Neill <michael.oneill@shuttletech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@shuttletech.com>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@shuttletech.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options — term and capacity

Rachel / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the options doc. After internal review we prefer Option B (24 months) but we need two clarifications before legal proceeds: 
1) Price hold: procurement needs a 90-day written price hold from the date of the commercial to allow approvals. Is that square with Redwood?
2) Phased commit: we want the phased increase at month 6 (not 7) and it should be optional for ShuttleTech to trigger — we won't commit to the second tranche until we hit the agreed usage threshold.

If Redwood can confirm those two items and put the phased schedule in the commercial spreadsheet, we can route to legal and aim to sign in early June.

Michael
Head of Data Platform
ShuttleTech

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neill <michael.oneill@shuttletech.com>, Procurement <procurement@shuttletech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options — term and capacity

Michael — great, appreciate the clarity. Confirming Redwood's position and the commercial terms we can commit to in the revised attachment: 

Final commercial (summary):
- Term: 24 months
- Year 1 recurring discount: 18% off list unit price (applied to committed units)
- Price hold: 90 days from date of signed commercial (we will include explicit language in SOW)
- Phased commit: optional tranche at Month 6 (you may elect to trigger up to +20% additional commit at the pre-agreed uplift in the spreadsheet)
- One-time onboarding credit: $40,000 tied to migration milestone (first month usage >= 80% of baseline)
- Legal: Redwood legal will accept standard limited redlines; please route any unusual clauses.

I've attached the Commit_Schedule.xlsx with the Month-6 optional trigger and the redline summary (redlines_docusign.pdf). If procurement confirms the timeline, we will issue an updated DocuSign for signature and preserve the 90-day price hold on the commercial terms.

Next step: please confirm procurement's preferred signatory and we will send the DocuSign package.

Attachments: Commit_Schedule.xlsx, redlines_docusign.pdf

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Commit_Schedule.xlsx)
(attachment: redlines_docusign.pdf)
